what: Citigroup is a global bank operating in more countries than any US rival. It moves money for multinational companies, trades, offers investment banking, issues credit cards and serves wealthy clients.
customers: Multinationals, governments, investors and US card customers.
moat: A payments network for corporations that spans roughly a hundred countries and is very hard to replicate.
risks: A long restructuring that must deliver
opportunities: Analysts see about 29% upside from current levels
Selling consumer banking businesses in several countries simplifies a notoriously complex bank
watch: Return on tangible equity and progress on the restructuring.
